title: unified-rollouts-multi-stage-canary-shadow-auto-rollback
author: Priya Kumar
release_notes: Adds multi-stage canary + shadow mirroring with metric-driven automated rollback. No public API changes; rollout config extended with 'stages' and 'mirror' flags.
body:
Motivation: Customers running production rollouts need finer-grained multi-stage canaries (staged ramp + shadow mirroring) and stronger automated rollback semantics when quality/regression metrics degrade. This PR implements a multi-stage canary flow, integrates shadow traffic mirroring for parallel metric collection, and wires automated metric-driven rollback policies that evaluate across primary and shadow cohorts.

What this changes: - rollout controller: add 'stages' array and per-stage traffic_percent + duration + metric thresholds - shadow mirror: optional 'mirror_to' target with sampling rate; shadow traffic goes to candidate model but does not impact live responses - metrics engine: aggregate side-by-side metrics for canary and shadow cohorts; new matching/downtime-tolerant comparison logic - rollback policy engine: supports multi-metric rules (latency P95, error-rate, prompt-quality score) and configurable lookback windows - UI/console: rollout page updated to show per-stage metrics, shadow cohort charts, and recommended auto-rollback triggers - SDK: rollout API accepts stages/mirror flags; backward compatible with existing single-stage configs

Design notes: - Metric comparison uses bootstrap-resilient thresholds to avoid false positives during low traffic stages. - Shadow traffic records are tagged and stored with 'rollout_id' + 'stage' for traceability. - Autoscaling and capacity routing respect shadow traffic when 'mirror_consume_capacity' is enabled (opt-in).

Files changed (high level): - rollout/controller.go: core state machine for multi-stage progression - rollout/policy/rollback.go: new rule evaluator and notifier hooks - telemetry/matcher.go: cohort comparison logic and smoothing - api/types/rollout_v2.proto: new rollout schema (stages, mirror fields) - console/src/components/RolloutDetails.tsx: charts and stage controls - sdk/python/redwood/rollouts.py: client bindings and examples - e2e/tests/rollouts_test.go: new integration tests for staged progression and rollback

Testing and validation: - unit tests for policy evaluation and comparator logic added - integration test that simulates a staging traffic ramp and triggers rollback on increased latency - local perf run against benchmark-lab (small internal perf test) to validate controller overhead - manual smoke: created a test rollout in staging and exercised stage transitions and rollback path

Migration and compatibility: - rollout_v2 is fully backwards-compatible: existing rollout configs still work and default to single-stage behavior - deployment plan: feature-flag gated for 2 weeks, roll out to 20% of tenants, monitor metrics; flag off will behave as no-op

Checklist: - [x] Design doc PR: ENG-4122 - [x] Tests added (unit + integration) - [x] Docs: console rollout docs + API examples - [x] QA run in staging - [x] Performance check (controller <2% overhead)

Notes for reviewers: Pay attention to metric matching logic (telemetry/matcher.go) and the safety bounds in policy/rollback.go. The 'mirror_consume_capacity' option is intentionally opt-in; we do not enable it by default to avoid surprise capacity consumption.

Related: references ENG-4122, PM-891, and SUP-2048 for customer-reported instability during prior rollouts.
commits_summary: a) Add rollout v2 schema and proto; b) Implement multi-stage state machine; c) Add shadow mirror plumbing and tagging; d) New rollback rule evaluator; e) Console + SDK updates; f) Tests and docs
files_changed: rollout/controller.go - implement multi-stage progression, guarded by feature flag
rollout/policy/rollback.go - metric-driven rollback evaluator and notifier hooks
sdk/python/redwood/rollouts.py - rollout client additions and examples
e2e/tests/rollouts_test.go - integration tests for staged rollouts
docs/rollouts.md - docs for multi-stage and shadow config
review_conversation: Alex Chen: Please double-check the smoothing window; during low-volume stages we saw noisy p95 spikes. Suggested using a 5m window by default.
Priya Kumar: Updated matcher.go to use adaptive 5m/30s window based on sample rate. Added unit tests covering low-volume behavior.
Morgan Lee: Can mirror traffic be routed to a different cluster? We should ensure network policies are respected.
Priya Kumar: Mirror routing uses existing 'mirror_to' topology; added validation to prevent cross-tenant routing and enforce KMS tagging.
Diego Ramirez: e2e failure on first run (timeout in rollout transition). Looks like controller goroutine leak under high churn.
Priya Kumar: Fixed leak by closing per-stage ticker and added additional integration retry logic. Re-ran e2e; green.
merge_details: Merged by Alex Chen using squash commit. Merge strategy: squash and merge. Merge commit message references ENG-4122 and includes rollout_v2 proto bump.
notes: Feature gated rollout_v2; ops runbook created and linked in Linear ENG-4122. Recommend monitoring rollout_controller_latency and rollout_rollback_rate for 72h after ramp.
manual_steps: 1) Flip feature flag for a small set of tenants; 2) Create a rollout with 3 stages (5%, 25%, 100%) and enable mirror at 10% sampling for candidate; 3) Observe stage metrics in console; 4) Validate automated rollback triggers on synthetic performance degradation.
